_comment: The SPS, the Scout and Pioneer Service (#3643, docs/developer/CIVILIZATIONS.md): the human exploration service that was destroyed centuries ago (docs/developer/LORE_STRUCTURE.md §A1) — the giant ships of its survey fleet Meridian among its wrecks. A legacy civilization — a tag only: its wrecks keep their own stampers, seeds, records and loot; the items, templates and loot tables that name "sps" are grouped under it.
